projects.title: SMK Plus Pelita Nusantara Website
projects.description: Website for SMK Plus Pelita Nusantara Bogor
projects.content:
SMK Plus Pelita Nusantara is an Vocational High School located in Cibinong, Bogor Regency. Guided by the motto "Success by Character," with a focus on developing skilled, entrepreneurial, and religious human resources, the school required a strong and easily accessible digital representation.

This project aimed to design and build a website platform that serves not only as a school profile but also as an integrated information center for new student admissions, a news portal, and documentation of student achievements.
